definition.deal: one shot; the bid is greater than or equal to the supplier reserve
definition.budget_violation: the bid is greater than the walk-away ceiling
definition.average_savings: mean of (opening - bid) / opening over deals only; n/a when there are no deals
definition.supplier: reserve is mandate target times the archetype reserve multiple; opening is reserve times one plus the bluff probability
definition.tradeflow: solver recommended opening, capped at the mandate ceiling
definition.offline_llm: accepts the supplier opening and does not read the ceiling
